Definition: something hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of besiegers), (abstractly) a siege, (figuratively) distress; or (subjectively) a fastness
BiblicalUsage: 1) siege-enclosure, siege, entrenchment, siege works; 1a) siege; 1b) enclosure, siege-works, rampart
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
